description: This file defines network tracing functionalities within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It implements methods for executing traceroute commands to network endpoints and processing their output, including specialized handling for IPv4 and IPv6 addresses. The file includes external command execution, string processing, and network validation utilities. It primarily contains methods to perform trace operations and generate JSON responses with the results.

classes.name: Network
classes.description: A class providing network utility methods such as traceroute operations within the WPEFramework plugin context.

methods.name: _doTraceNamedEndpoint
methods.description: Performs a traceroute to a named endpoint, supporting only 'CMTS' in current implementation. It retrieves the default interface and executes a trace if possible.

methods.name: _doTrace
methods.description: Executes a traceroute command (IPv4 or IPv6) to the specified endpoint, gathering output and converting it into a JSON response with results or error messages.
